changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwuomgroup AS SELECT ug.id, ug.description, ug.name, ug.is_active FROM public.uom_group ug;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwuomgroup TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwuomgroup FROM report_user;
